Terms

By playing AfconCity or booking an ad in it, you agree to these terms. They are written to be read.

Playing

  • AfconCity is free to play. The game is offered as it is, and features may change or be removed.
  • Tanzanian shillings in the game are play money. They have no real value, cannot be bought, sold or exchanged, and are not a prize.
  • The VIP ticket, passport stamps and anything you win in the game exist only in the game. They are not tickets to a real match.
  • AfconCity is an independent fan game. It is not run by, endorsed by or connected to CAF, the Africa Cup of Nations, any national team or federation. Jerseys in the game use national colours, not official kits.
  • Real places in Fumba and Zanzibar are shown for fun. Prices, businesses and people in the game are simplified or invented.

Behaving well

  • Be kind in chat. No insults, hate, harassment, threats, sexual content, spam, scams or sharing anyone's personal details.
  • Never ask other players, especially young players, for contact details, photos or to meet.
  • Do not cheat in ways that spoil the game for others, attack the service, or pretend to be the AfconCity team.
  • We may filter messages, remove leaderboard entries and block players who break these rules, without warning.
  • Use the Report button on a player to tell us about a problem.

Save codes and progress

Your save code is the key to your cloud save: anyone who has it can load your game, so keep it to yourself. We do our best to keep saves safe, but we cannot promise that progress will never be lost.

Advertising

  • Brands can book billboards, the radio and phone ads on our brands page. A booking is confirmed when payment succeeds and we approve the design.
  • Ads must be legal, truthful and suitable for all ages. We do not accept ads for gambling, alcohol, tobacco, weapons, adult content, political campaigns or anything aimed at misleading players.
  • We may decline or remove an ad that breaks these rules. If we decline a paid booking before it goes live, we refund it in full. Once an ad has gone live, refunds are for the days not yet shown, at our discretion.
  • View counts we report are estimates from players who are online and signed in.
  • You confirm you own or have permission to use any name, logo or text you submit.

Our responsibility

To the extent the law allows, AfconCity is not liable for indirect losses, lost progress or interruptions to the service. Nothing in these terms limits rights you have under consumer law where you live.
